run_lora_a_embedding: run the TritonLoRABackend LoRA A embedding lookup with input ids, weights, and vocab size
run_lora_b_sgemm: run the TritonLoRABackend LoRA B sparse GEMM operation with input tensor and weights
run_qkv_lora: run the TritonLoRABackend QKV projection with LoRA A and LoRA B matrices
run_gate_up_lora: run the TritonLoRABackend gate and up FFN layers with LoRA A and LoRA B matrices
prepare_lora_batch: prepare the TritonLoRABackend LoRA batch info from forward batch, weight indices, ranks, and scalings
